criteria.answered: the user asked a question and this message answers it
criteria.done: finished the work and verified it, and is reporting results
criteria.handing_back: stops with work the agent could do itself: asks permission for something reversible, tells the owner to run commands, or proposes next steps or options instead of doing them
criteria.owner_only: needs the owner personally: rotating their passwords or tokens, account logins, payments, deleting their only copy of data, publishing to a third party, or destroying work the agent does not own (another session's files or processes, the owner's data, a shared host)
criteria.waiting_on_background: workers or background jobs are running and will notify the agent when they finish, so there is nothing else to do right now
